review_notes: I read all of lines 1–62. I looked for nontrivial reasoning repeated across proofs. The only visible repetition is that two instances (finite and infinite adele rings) each end with `UniformSpace.secondCountable_of_separable _`. In each case that is a one-line call to an existing Mathlib lemma. The surrounding steps are different. The finite case gets separability from `HeightOneSpectrum.denseRange_algebraMap` and builds a restricted-product instance. The infinite case uses `WithAbs.equiv` countability and transfers the result along `isometryEquivCompletion`. The countability instances (`Countable (Ideal R)`, `Countable (HeightOneSpectrum R)`, and `Countable (𝓞 K)`) are each short surjectivity or injectivity arguments that use `.countable`. They share no proof block large enough to extract. A shared helper would be a thin wrapper around existing API, which the rubric excludes. I did not open the related Mathlib sources, so I did not check whether a Mathlib lemma already covers any of these steps. That is outside this rubric.
